title: Symfony Code Mode · Claude follows a team procedure
audio: Original synthesized sound effects, no speech.

chapters.title: Ask Claude to follow the procedure
One program reads the order and policy

capture.application: Claude Code 2.1.330 in macOS Terminal.app, captured with ScreenCaptureKit
capture.scope: The CLI excerpts show the original conversation reopened in the installed Claude Code client. During the original plain claude run, a support colleague asked one question. Claude chose the Group, wrote the dependent reads and answered. Reopening the transcript for the camera did not run the tools a second time.

editing.opening: The first 39 seconds use shorter cuts of the catalog explainer, preserving its measured synthetic startup definitions and its two model-free PHP MCP SDK sessions. One session exercised search_tools and execute_tools. The other used the draft groups/list and groups/get methods.
editing.groupDiscovery: Claude opened refund-review through the group argument of search_tools. The native draft methods shown earlier were called by the PHP MCP SDK client.
editing.program: The original Claude Code conversation contains one JavaScript program that calls the order reader, extracts the order's policy ID and supplies it to the policy reader. The linked receipt includes the complete source, both tools/call requests, their results and Symfony dispatch events.
editing.capture: All terminal text shown in the final 51 seconds is cropped from the native CLI display. The edit labels the reopened session and leaves the lower-left corner available for an avatar. The edit presents excerpts of the detailed transcript in conversation order. The original request and model-invoked calls were recorded before this screen capture.

excerpts.label: The question
excerpts.shows: The employee asks Claude to find and follow the refund procedure for order R-1042.

excerpts.label: Open refund-review
excerpts.shows: The native transcript expands Claude's Group lookup. Both the generated search and its search_tools MCP call name refund-review.

excerpts.label: Claude’s JavaScript
excerpts.shows: The operator expands the original JavaScript in Claude's transcript. The same block reads order R-1042, extracts its policy ID and passes it to the policy reader.

excerpts.label: The order returns its policy ID
excerpts.shows: The real order response includes the policy ID standard-eu and the paid amount.

excerpts.label: The next call uses that ID
excerpts.shows: The execute_tools call for refund_get_policy carries the returned standard-eu ID.

excerpts.label: Check the policy
excerpts.shows: The native CLI table compares nine days with a thirty-day limit, the item condition, and the seventy-five euro order with the fifty-euro review threshold.

excerpts.label: The recommendation
excerpts.shows: Claude recommends manual review before issuing a refund.
